title: renderPage({ embed }) wires renderThemeControl() into the shell header .tools group; embed path strips the control
description: Baz 2026-10-04 (w-2026-10-04-dave-001): `renderPage(model, { embed })` renders the three-state theme control from `renderThemeControl()` immediately after the SearchButton inside `<div class="tools">`. When `embed` is true the markup is skipped entirely (ADR-4137 server-side layer) so no `[data-rcf-theme-control]` element is emitted; the production server path never passes `embed`, and the client-side layer in `page-init.js` strips the element on boot when `?embed=1` is present.
